psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies
psnprofiles.note: grades and PSN counts; agrees with Exophase on every name, description and grade

powerpyx.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
powerpyx.note: difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, the missable warning, and the 100% checklist counts

own.label: Our own advice, worked out from the official description

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks on its own — no separate task. PowerPyx rates the whole road to the platinum 4 out of 10 for difficulty and about 200 hours, with A Long Road (100% completion) the longest grind. One playthrough is enough, there are no online trophies and no DLC is needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so it unlocks as you start the story — nothing to prepare, just play.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story progress only — keep playing the main missions. One warning for this chapter: meditate at the first meditation spot the moment the game offers it (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only — the trophy lands when the chapter's last mission ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progress only — the trophy lands when the chapter's last mission ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progress only — the trophy lands when the chapter's last mission ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. PowerPyx counts five chapters in the story, and this gold unlocks when the last mission ends — after which free-roam continues, so the post-story cleanup can begin. There is no mission replay, but nothing here is missable: the trophy is story progress.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — it unlocks as you play through the chapters, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — it unlocks as you play through the chapters, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story mission — it unlocks as you play through the chapters, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story mission — it unlocks as you play through the chapters, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission — it unlocks as you play through the chapters, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — it unlocks as you play through the chapters, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the longest trophy in the list and the hardest, by PowerPyx's ranking. The good news is the checklist is lenient: PowerPyx puts it at about 60% true completion. You need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons and 15 of 18 card sets. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, and most of it is finished by chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game, and the 100% checklist wants 300 — so keep pulling stunts whenever you see a jump or a ramp, and this lands on the way to 100%. The game tracks your count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — 9 types in all, by the official list's own count. Sample one of each: a race, the shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, a challenge and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them all, just try each kind once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 of them, by the official list's count. Work through every range challenge and hit the gold score on each; a silver trophy for a full set of golds. Take your time and learn each range's targets before going for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in all, by the official list's count. You need one win per location, not a win in every race: visit each drone race spot, win once, move on.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — vary the events rather than repeating one favourite, and the wins stack up across cars, bikes and boats.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — fishing is one of the activities, so practise the casting and reeling first if the challenge feels tight.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade machine, play its game through to the end, and the trophy pops — no high score needed, just a finish.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission — these character strands run long, so start them when they appear rather than leaving them all for after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission — start the strand when it appears, since it runs long.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission — start the strand when it appears, since it runs long.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. PowerPyx lists Strangers & Freaks as the game's side missions: meet strangers out in the world, play each one's strand through, and finish any 8 of them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission — start the strand when it appears, since it runs long.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission — start the strand when it appears, since it runs long.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx flags this as the only trophy in the game that may be missable: the first meditation is in Chapter 1 and can be missed. Meditate at the first spot the moment the game offers it, then keep meditating at every spot you find — 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia, by PowerPyx's count. This is the one trophy to watch: PowerPyx calls it the only potentially missable trophy in the game, because the first meditation in Chapter 1 can be missed. Meditate at the first spot the moment the game offers it, then meditate at every spot you come across for the rest of the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the unique animal he names, and bring it down — hunting is one of the side strands, so follow Bret's missions to the hunt itself.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PowerPyx counts 18 sets holding 480 unique cards; any 3 complete sets unlock this, while 100% completion wants 15 sets. Collect cards as you go and finish the smallest sets first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Photograph or tag 100 WAiNK spots around Leonida — the game tracks your count, so keep tagging every spot you pass and the silver lands well before you have seen the whole map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. PowerPyx counts 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10 — any 50 unlock this, and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so you can skip the hardest ones entirely. Pick the categories you enjoy and work through them.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight, stay out of the search area and wait until the wanted level clears — do not get caught, and do not let your partner get caught either.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — plan a route of three close shops, keep moving, and do not let the heat drop to zero before the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive — or scan, where the game lets you — every new vehicle you meet; PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277, so keep discovering and this comes first.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and drop 5 before it ends — a crowded fight is the place to try it, not a lone enemy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. Get to the airport, take a plane that was not scheduled to leave with you in it, and get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — Rhinos are tanks. The official description gives no step-by-step, only the joke, so expect tank combat or a tank encounter; check the linked PowerPyx guide as players pin the exact trigger down, and do not guess at it from the name alone.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — take the goods and get out clean. If anyone raises the alarm, leave and try another store rather than fighting through it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean after each — the escape counts, so plan your getaway before you go in, and do not count a vault where you get caught.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop an armored truck on the road, take its cargo and escape with the take — a fast car and a quiet road help more than a loud one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in all, by the official list's count. Visit every named area until the map is complete; the game tracks which areas you have seen, so sweep the corners of the map last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all, by the official list's count. Hit one illegal operation per gang and the trophy pops; you do not need to clear every operation, just one for each gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view. PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known in detail, so the description is all there is to go on — try the bars along the beachfront.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front in style — the classic way out. PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known in detail, so the description is the guide for now: a showroom, a car, and a dramatic exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — one full game at that alley is what the trophy asks for.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — expect a moment with your partner that draws a crowd. No source has pinned the exact trigger down yet, so play the partner moments as they come and check the linked guide as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make choices as you play — the game tracks them, and the trophy follows from playing through the story's decisions. The official description gives no number, so play naturally and let it come rather than hunting for a count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try. PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known in detail — most likely a retry moment — so the description is all there is to go on for now.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange out in Leonida — an odd event, not a mission. PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known, so keep an eye out while free-roaming; strange things tend to happen when you least expect them.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known in detail — the name says it all: a drive-by, with a melee weapon, that bowls the target over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean — the total is tracked for you, so keep feeding bills through whenever you have them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shop spending counts across every store, and it adds up over a full playthrough — cars, clothes, weapons and everything in between. There is no need to rush it; it lands by itself if you spend as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all, by the official list's count. Buy every garage property on the market; save the money for them as you go, and the last purchase pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — any ten will do, so register the cars you drive most and top the list up with anything new you find.
